features.title: Curated discovery with thoughtful experiences
features.subtitle: Instanct brings map-based discovery, professional profiles, live chat, and meeting tools together in one place.

nearbyDiscovery.title: Nearby discovery
nearbyDiscovery.description: Explore professionals around you on a live map. Filter by industry and objectives to find people who match what you are looking for.

profiles.title: Profiles that go further
profiles.description: Showcase experience, education, industries, and intent so the right people can find you — and you can find them.

messaging.title: Real-time messaging
messaging.description: Chat with networking contacts, share media, and send a poke when a lightweight hello is all you need.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Share when you are available to connect. Others nearby can see you are open, then start a conversation with context.

meetingRequests.title: Meeting requests
meetingRequests.description: Send or receive meeting requests with a time and place. Accepted meetings land on your schedule automatically.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks & activities
bookmarks.description: Save interesting profiles, keep incoming and outgoing requests in one place, and stay on top of what matters today.

howItWorks.title: From nearby to meaningful, in three steps

01.title: Create your profile
01.description: Add your photo, bio, experience, education, and industries. Sign in with email, Google, Apple, or LinkedIn.

02.title: Explore who is nearby
02.description: Open the map, apply filters, and discover people around you who share your objectives or industry.

03.title: Connect with confidence
03.description: Start a session, send a meeting request, or open a chat. Instanct is built for connections that feel human-first.

showcase.title: Tools that help people connect with confidence
showcase.body: We build for meaningful connections based on shared interests, local discovery that stays human-first, and experiences that prioritize safety, trust, and inclusion.

highlights.sessions: Share when you are available to connect
highlights.chat: Chat, poke, and bookmark in one flow

explore.title: Explore
explore.body: See who is around you, then open a profile to learn about their experience, education, and intent.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: Tell the community you are ready to connect. Others nearby can reach out while you are available.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Propose a meeting with a message, time, and place. Accepted requests are added to your schedule.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Keep the conversation going with real-time messaging, media, and lightweight pokes.

safety.title: Designed with trust at the core
safety.subtitle: Clear policies, proactive moderation, and settings that keep you in control of what you share.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Location is only used when you enable it, to power map and nearby features. You control visibility from Settings.

community.title: Community standards
community.description: Harassment, impersonation, and harmful content are not allowed. We can suspend accounts that break these terms.

content.title: You own your content
content.description: You own what you share. Instanct only hosts and displays it to operate the service, and you can delete your account at any time.

whatIsInstanct.question: What is Instanct?
whatIsInstanct.answer: Instanct is a professional discovery app. It helps people find nearby professionals, start sessions, send meeting requests, and chat — with privacy and trust at the core.

location.question: Is my location always shared?
location.answer: No. Location data is collected only when enabled, to power map and nearby features. You can manage visibility and preferences in Settings.

sessions.question: How do sessions work?
sessions.answer: A session tells others you are available to connect. You choose when it starts and ends so people nearby understand your intent before they reach out.

platforms.question: Which platforms are supported?
platforms.answer: The Instanct experience is built for iOS and Android. A web backoffice exists for administration. The product is available in English, French, and Arabic.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Open Settings, then Session, and choose Remove Account. Account deletion permanently removes your data and cannot be undone.

cta.title: Start your first session
cta.body: Join Instanct to discover nearby professionals, share when you are available, and build connections that feel at home in your community.
